strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets an admitted verification recovery task move from bounded failed-verifier diagnostics to one runtime-owned context excerpt without external raw file reading.
Materializes a single bounded diagnostic-guided excerpt into the in-memory recovery prompt while keeping prompt/file content out of ledger and RPC surfaces.
Revalidates recovery provenance, failure fingerprint, current task identity, ReadWorkspace permission, and path safety immediately before reading.
Records replay-safe context-read metadata, hashes, line range, byte counts, redaction status, and next action without raw source text.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting context_management, runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and controlled_workspace_tools.
answers.new_capability: A current verification recovery task.run can explicitly authorize one diagnostic-guided workspace context read, and the runtime injects a bounded excerpt into the in-memory recovery prompt.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Existing bounded diagnostics only identify a safe location. selected_index_context requires a separate index-selected read and caller-supplied context evidence, so it does not provide a direct provenance-owned recovery read path.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless recovery remains blocked between knowing which verifier diagnostic failed and safely gathering the source context needed to repair it.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M30.1 added bounded cargo-test diagnostics, M29.1 added controlled cargo-test execution, and M28.1 added recovery apply continuation; this phase adds a new runtime-owned read action from recovery provenance.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. It extends existing task.run request/result shapes rather than adding a read/report/inspection endpoint.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It returns bounded task.run metadata and writes one ledger metadata event, with no report, digest, history, readiness, preview, or capability wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime validates authorization/provenance/permission/path, reads one regular UTF-8 workspace file excerpt, hashes it, injects it into prompt construction, and records replay metadata.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can proceed from failed verification evidence to repair-context execution without reading raw files outside Brownie's Rust authority.
answers.milestone_progress: This is the core M31 vertical slice and should make the milestone closeout-eligible once tests and review confirm the no-raw-content boundary.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M31.1 must be reviewed for actual runtime-owned diagnostic-guided read behavior, prompt-only raw excerpt handling, metadata-only ledger/RPC output, permission enforcement, and replay safety.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M31.1 changes runtime/context/protocol behavior and current phase manifests; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: task.run accepts verification_recovery_context_read only for current verification recovery tasks with matching current recovery provenance and explicit authorization.
The runtime revalidates ReadWorkspace and denies unsafe, absolute, parent-traversing, protected, directory, symlink, missing, or non-UTF-8 targets.
Exactly one bounded excerpt is read from one existing regular UTF-8 workspace file and injected only into the in-memory recovery prompt.

Ledger events and TaskRunResult include bounded metadata, hashes, line range, byte count, replay status, and next_action without raw excerpt, prompt, file content, stdout, stderr, commands, environment, absolute paths, canonical paths, or secrets.
Replay returns the persisted bounded context-read summary without rereading file content or duplicating context-read evidence.

VSIX protocol validation accepts valid request/summary metadata and rejects raw excerpt/content/path/prompt fields, invalid hashes, invalid line ranges, over-budget excerpts, unknown fields, and invalid authorization.
No new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, preview, capability, or inspection wrapper is added.

tests: runtime client verification recovery context read validation

next_phase_candidate_notes: After M31.1 lands, close out M31 if review confirms the diagnostic-guided context read is end-to-end and replay safe. Do not add context read reports, histories, readiness wrappers, or generic workspace reads.
